title: tragacantha casei
intro: Tragacantha casei, commonly known as the Case's needle-grass, is a plant species native to Australia. It is known for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Tragacantha casei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including skin infections, wounds, and gastrointestinal disorders, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
